definitions.explanation: A thick pad or glove used to handle hot pots, pans, and dishes in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}つかみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍋|なべ}つかみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need a pot holder when carrying a hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鍋|なべ}つかみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother gave me a handmade pot holder as a gift.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (pot) and つかみ (grabbing, from ⟦{掴|つか}む→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧). Refers to the protective pad or glove used to handle hot cookware.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鍋|なべ}つかみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a pot holder
- {鍋|なべ}つかみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold with a pot holder
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鍋|なべ}つかみ: handmade pot holder

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ミトン→ミトン：27555_miton⟧: oven mitt (loanword from English "mitten")
- ⟦{鍋敷|なべし}き→鍋敷き：06508_nabeshiki⟧: trivet, pot stand — placed under hot pots on a table, not used for holding
